stages.name: truth
stages.claim: Synthetic SAR truth, with the true retention probability 0.5.

stages.name: omit-retention
stages.claim: Omit retention and the recovered kernel is about half the true magnitude.

stages.name: retention-recovers
stages.claim: With the gate on, shape and magnitude recover; non-linearity is 0.47 for the truth against 0.48 with the gate off.

stages.name: omit-selection
stages.claim: Omit neighbour selection and the kernel is smoothed, a Berkson-like effect: non-linearity 0.35 against a truth of 0.63.

stages.name: selection-recovers
stages.claim: Selecting the neighbour recovers the shape.

stages.name: held-out-scores
stages.claim: The linear against RFF held-out difference is 0.019 nats without retention and 0.144 with it, about six times larger.
